description: This file defines interfaces for GPG signature verification, including structures, enums, and function prototypes related to signature checking, format validation, signing, and trust levels.

methods.name: signature_check_clear
methods.description: Clears or resets the signature_check structure.

methods.name: get_signature_format
methods.description: Returns the format of the signature, such as 'openpgp', 'x509', 'ssh', or 'unknown'.

methods.name: valid_signature_format
methods.description: Checks if the signature format is valid.

methods.name: parse_signature
methods.description: Parses a GPG signed tag object to extract signature and payload.

methods.name: parse_signed_buffer
methods.description: Analyzes signed content to find embedded detached signatures.

methods.name: sign_buffer
methods.description: Creates a detached signature for the buffer content.

methods.name: gpg_trust_level_to_str
methods.description: Converts trust level enum to its string representation.

methods.name: set_signing_key
methods.description: Sets the signing key used for signatures.

methods.name: get_signing_key_id
methods.description: Returns a unique identifier for the signing key.

methods.name: check_signature
methods.description: Verifies a signature against the signature_check structure.

methods.name: print_signature_buffer
methods.description: Outputs signature information with specified flags.

methods.name: parse_sign_mode
methods.description: Parses a string argument into a sign_mode enum.
